about: Shared cases for the text pipeline of the Mac app (Sources/*.swift) and the Windows app (windows/src/Inlaut.Core).
Tests/TextPipelineCorpusTests.swift and windows/tests/Inlaut.CoreSmoke run every case.
step: "dictation" (default) runs the whole pipeline after a dictation: a snippet, else voice commands, ß and replacements. "voiceCommands" and "sharpS" run one step.

languages (required for dictation and voiceCommands): "german" and/or "english", the languages being dictated. voiceCommands and sharpS default to true; replacements and snippets use the rules-file format.
expected must hold on both platforms. Where they differ on purpose or pending a decision, "mac" and "windows" replace it and "differences" names the known reasons below.

When a change makes both platforms agree, replace "mac" and "windows" with "expected". Both runners reject unknown keys, keys the step does not use, equal mac and windows values and unused differences.
